text:
Predicates:
City(x) ::: x is a city.
State(x, y) ::: x is in state y.
SameState(x, y) ::: x and y are in the same state.
Home(x, y) ::: x is the home of y.
Premises:
City(billings) ∧ State(billings, montana) ::: Billings is a city in Montana.
City(butte) ∧ City(helena) ∧ City(missoula) ∧ State(butte, montana) ∧ State(helena, montana) ∧ State(missoula, montana) ::: Montana includes the cities of Butte, Helena, and Missoula.
City(whiteSulphurSprings) ∧ City(butte) ∧ SameState(whiteSulphurSprings, butte) ::: White Sulphur Springs and Butte are cities in the same state.
¬City(pierre) ∧ ¬State(pierre, montana) ::: The city of Pierre is not in Montana.
∀x (City(x) ∧ State(x, butte) → ¬State(x, pierre)) ::: Any city in Butte is not in Pierre.
Conclusion:
Home(montana, missoula) ::: Montana is home to the city of Missoula.
